# Code Mode

The tools listed below cannot be called directly: they only work as JavaScript inside the `execute` tool. Every other tool you have is a normal tool call: call it directly, never inside `execute`.

The catalog is complete. Do not guess tool names.

## Code Mode tools (call only inside `execute`)

- github (3 tools)
  - tools.github.create_issue({
  title: string,
}): Promise<string | null> // Create an issue.
  - tools.github.get_issue({
  id: number,
}): Promise<string | null> // Get an issue.
  - tools.github.list_issues({}): Promise<string | null> // List issues.
- read (1 tool)
  - tools.read({
  file_path: string,
}): Promise<string | null> // Read a file.
    // Second line.
    // Third line.
- search (1 tool)
  - tools.search({ query: string }): Promise<string | null> // Search ünïcode ✨ and a very long first line that should be clipped only when it exceeds the two thousand character description limit; this one is short enough.
